Detail

Why we do not print fixed prices

Entry, parking and documentation fees can change and differ between sources. Rather than publish figures that may be outdated, this guide recommends asking staff the current price before paying.

Detail

Cost components visitors usually ask about

  • Entry ticket or local retribution.
  • Parking for two-wheel and four-wheel vehicles.
  • Specific photo or documentation services.
  • Food, drinks and personal needs.

Detail

Paying practically

Carry small cash. Ask for current prices and conditions before using any service, and keep a receipt if one is given.

No official price is guaranteed; treat every fee as 'check at the gate' until staff confirm it.

Frequently asked questions

How much is the entry ticket to Pinus Pengger?

This guide has not verified the entry ticket price. Ask the current rate from staff on site before paying, as fees can change and vary by source.

Is there a parking fee?

Parking availability and rates are unverified. Ask staff about location, capacity and cost, then follow on-site directions.

Is there a charge for cameras or photos?

Some installations or documentation services may carry a fee. Ask about specific photos and installations separately before paying.

Can entry be free?

Whether entry is free or paid cannot be confirmed from the public sources we found. Confirm directly with staff to avoid wrong assumptions.
